prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers were dispatched to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle that was struck on the passenger side by Driver 2, whose vehicle entered the intersection against the signal. Driver 1 presented proof of insurance at the scene, and the policy listed Driver 1 as a named insured. Driver 1 was seen seated in the driver's position, and Passenger was also confirmed to be inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury and was transported for treatment. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle entered the intersection without stopping, and this account matched statements from two independent witnesses who saw the collision. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle and the passenger side of Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the angle and force of the impact. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Based on the evidence gathered, the collision occurred as described by the parties and witnesses.
